segments.title: Giraffe tongues are blue!
segments.say: Giraffe part two! Their tongues are blue-black! With Lesedi from Botswana.

segments.title: How long is its tongue?
segments.say: How long is a giraffe's tongue? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Up to 20 inches!
segments.say: Up to twenty inches! Longer than a ruler.

segments.title: It reaches high leaves
segments.say: It helps reach leaves high up in the trees.

segments.title: Why so dark?
segments.say: The dark color may keep its tongue from getting sunburned!
